audit.summary: Two Major core proof defects supported by explicit graph counterexamples: F1 boundary-only trip criteria omit closed straight trajectories; F2 a valid web needs two preparatory benzene moves, contradicting the immediate next-iteration reduction in Algorithm 7.1/Theorem 7.2. No counterexample to the principal web-basis theorem. A direct boundary-coverage invariant is verified for actual growth outputs. Current focused independent acceptance is recorded in independent_verification.

proposition.claim:
The stated boundary-started trip criteria miss closed straight trajectories. Proposition 3.21's sufficiency and Corollary 3.33's literal monotonicity converse fail even for a connected graph with boundary.

The reduction algorithm's demand for a benzene move creating a forbidden square, and its claim of a square reduction on the immediately subsequent iteration, fail on a valid web.

repair.content:
Add and prove the needed control of all closed straight trajectories/boundary coverage in the global criterion. For actual growth outputs, each live wire retains one distinct original boundary endpoint; X passes wires through, and a cap completes a boundary-to-boundary arc. This independently excludes closed trip2 trajectories and removes this particular obstruction on growth outputs. A full corrected global theorem is not certified here.

Specify and justify a finite preparatory witness sequence and a well-founded recursive measure controlling face number, progress along the witness, and lower-face skein side terms. Arbitrary benzene moves can undo the first flip. A general corrected reduction schedule is not proved by this review.
